title: IAEA Live Chart: 222Rn half-life 3.8222 d (uncertainty from the seconds column)
summary: The Live Chart row for 222Rn lists half-life 3.8222 with unit d. The seconds columns fix the absolute uncertainty at 0.0009 days.
body: The IAEA Live Chart ground-state row for 222Rn (Z=86, N=136), extracted 2026-11-18, lists half_life 3.8222, unit_hl d, unc_hl 9, half_life_sec 330238.08, and unc_hls 77.76. Dividing half_life_sec by half_life gives 86400 seconds per unit, so unit code d is days in this row. Dividing unc_hls by that same number gives an absolute uncertainty of 0.0009 days. The small integer unc_hl (9) matches that absolute uncertainty as 9 in the last significant place of the printed half-life, not as 9 days on its own. The leading decay field is A at 100 percent. The row's ENSDF publication cut-off field is 25-Sep-2023. This is the database row, not a new laboratory measurement made for this card.

sources.title: IAEA Live Chart ground state 222Rn

history.note: Truth gate ceiling. The only source host is iaea.org, class other, whose ceiling is weak. The Live Chart row was not changed and no source was added.

Linked the October 2023 NNDC wallet-card half-life world.physics.nndc-rn-222-half-life. The IAEA numerals in this card were not rewritten. iaea.org remains class other, so this card's evidence stays weak.
